بُرْعُومٌ and ↓ بُرْعُمٌ (S, K) and ↓ بُرْعُومَةٌ and ↓ بُرْعُمَةٌ (K) The calyx of the fruit, or produce, of a tree: (K:) and blossoms, or white blossoms, syn. نَوْرٌ, (K TA,) before they open: (TA:) or flowers, (S, and Msb in explanation of the first word in art. زهر,) or the flower of a tree, (K,) before the opening thereof: (S, Msb ubi suprà, K:) pl. بَرَاعِيمُ. (S, TA.) ―
-b2- بَرَاعِيمُ also signifies The heads, or tops; or round, high, slender tops; or peaks; (شَمَارِيخ;) of mountains: (AZ, K:) sing. ↓ بُرْعُومَةٌ . (AZ, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
